datasets.name: Tyrannosaurus
datasets.text: Tyrannosaurus is a Large theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (68-66 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: USA, Canada. Length: 12.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Tyrannosauridae. Named by Henry Fairfield Osborn in 1905. One of the largest land predators ever. Famous for its tiny arms and massive skull with bone-crushing jaws.

datasets.name: Triceratops
datasets.text: Triceratops is a Ceratopsid dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (68-66 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: USA, Canada. Length: 9.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Ceratopsidae. Named by Othniel Charles Marsh in 1889. Three-horned dinosaur with a large bony frill. Likely used horns for defense against predators like T. rex.

datasets.name: Velociraptor
datasets.text: Velociraptor is a Small dromaeosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (75-71 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: Mongolia, China. Length: 2.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Dromaeosauridae. Named by Henry Fairfield Osborn in 1924. Swift pack hunter, covered in feathers. Much smaller than depicted in movies, about the size of a turkey.

datasets.name: Brachiosaurus
datasets.text: Brachiosaurus is a Sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Jurassic period (154-153 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: USA, Tanzania. Length: 26.0 meters. Taxonomy: Sauropoda > Brachiosauridae. Named by Elmer S. Riggs in 1903. Enormous long-necked dinosaur with front legs longer than hind legs, allowing it to reach high vegetation.

datasets.name: Stegosaurus
datasets.text: Stegosaurus is a Stegosaurid dinosaur that lived during the Late Jurassic period (155-150 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: USA, Portugal. Length: 9.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Stegosauridae. Named by Othniel Charles Marsh in 1877. Recognizable by two rows of large bony plates along the back and spiked tail used for defense.

datasets.name: Diplodocus
datasets.text: Diplodocus is a Sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Jurassic period (154-152 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: USA. Length: 27.0 meters. Taxonomy: Sauropoda > Diplodocidae. Named by Othniel Charles Marsh in 1878. One of the longest dinosaurs, with an extremely long neck and whip-like tail.

datasets.name: Ankylosaurus
datasets.text: Ankylosaurus is a Ankylosaurid dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (68-66 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: USA, Canada. Length: 6.25 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Ankylosauridae. Named by Barnum Brown in 1908. Heavily armored dinosaur with a massive bony club at the end of its tail used to break predator bones.

datasets.name: Spinosaurus
datasets.text: Spinosaurus is a Large theropod dinosaur that lived during the Cretaceous period (99-93 million years ago). Diet: Piscivore. Found in: Egypt, Morocco. Length: 15.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Spinosauridae. Named by Ernst Stromer in 1915. Likely the largest carnivorous dinosaur. Had a large sail on its back and was adapted for aquatic hunting.

datasets.name: Allosaurus
datasets.text: Allosaurus is a Large theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Jurassic period (155-150 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: USA, Portugal, Tanzania. Length: 9.7 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Allosauridae. Named by Othniel Charles Marsh in 1877. Apex predator of the Jurassic, with sharp serrated teeth and three-fingered clawed hands.

datasets.name: Parasaurolophus
datasets.text: Parasaurolophus is a Hadrosaur dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (76-73 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: USA, Canada. Length: 9.5 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Hadrosauridae. Named by William Parks in 1922. Duck-billed dinosaur with a distinctive hollow crest used to produce resonating calls for communication.

datasets.name: Iguanodon
datasets.text: Iguanodon is a Iguanodontid dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (126-113 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Belgium, UK, Germany. Length: 10.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Iguanodontidae. Named by Gideon Mantell in 1825. One of the first dinosaurs to be scientifically described. Had a distinctive spiked thumb used for defense.

datasets.name: Pteranodon
datasets.text: Pteranodon is a Pterosaur dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (86-84 million years ago). Diet: Piscivore. Found in: USA. Length: 1.8 meters. Taxonomy: Pterosauria > Pteranodontidae. Named by Othniel Charles Marsh in 1876. Flying reptile, not a true dinosaur, with a wingspan up to 7 meters and a toothless beak.

datasets.name: Pachycephalosaurus
datasets.text: Pachycephalosaurus is a Pachycephalosaurid dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (70-66 million years ago). Diet: Omnivore. Found in: USA. Length: 4.5 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Pachycephalosauridae. Named by Barnum Brown & Eric Mowbray Schlaikjer in 1943. Thick-domed skull used in head-butting contests for dominance. Bipedal herbivore of the late Cretaceous.

datasets.name: Carnotaurus
datasets.text: Carnotaurus is a Abelisaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (72-69 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: Argentina. Length: 7.5 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Abelisauridae. Named by José Bonaparte in 1985. Distinctive for its two bull-like horns above the eyes. One of the fastest large predators.

datasets.name: Giganotosaurus
datasets.text: Giganotosaurus is a Large theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (99-97 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: Argentina. Length: 12.5 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Carcharodontosauridae. Named by Rodolfo Coria & Leonardo Salgado in 1995. One of the largest carnivorous dinosaurs, comparable in size to T. rex but lived 30 million years earlier.

datasets.name: Argentinosaurus
datasets.text: Argentinosaurus is a Titanosaur sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (96-92 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Argentina. Length: 35.0 meters. Taxonomy: Sauropoda > Titanosauria. Named by José Bonaparte & Rodolfo Coria in 1993. Possibly the heaviest dinosaur ever, estimated at 70-80 tonnes, found in Patagonia, Argentina.

datasets.name: Deinonychus
datasets.text: Deinonychus is a Dromaeosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (115-108 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: USA. Length: 3.4 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Dromaeosauridae. Named by John Ostrom in 1969. Pack hunter with an enlarged sickle-shaped claw on each foot. Discovery revolutionized dinosaur science.

datasets.name: Compsognathus
datasets.text: Compsognathus is a Small theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Jurassic period (150-145 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: Germany, France. Length: 1.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Compsognathidae. Named by Johann A. Wagner in 1859. One of the smallest dinosaurs known, roughly the size of a chicken. Swift two-legged predator.

datasets.name: Maiasaura
datasets.text: Maiasaura is a Hadrosaur dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (76-75 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: USA. Length: 9.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Hadrosauridae. Named by Jack Horner & Robert Makela in 1979. Good mother lizard - first dinosaur found with evidence of parental care, nesting in colonies.

datasets.name: Oviraptor
datasets.text: Oviraptor is a Oviraptorid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (75-71 million years ago). Diet: Omnivore. Found in: Mongolia. Length: 1.8 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Oviraptoridae. Named by Henry Fairfield Osborn in 1924. Egg thief - though initially accused of stealing eggs, later found to be brooding its own nest.

datasets.name: Protoceratops
datasets.text: Protoceratops is a Ceratopsid dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (75-71 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Mongolia. Length: 1.8 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Protoceratopsidae. Named by Walter Granger & William K. Gregory in 1923. Small frilled dinosaur from the Gobi Desert. Often found in death battles with Velociraptor fossils.

datasets.name: Hadrosaurus
datasets.text: Hadrosaurus is a Hadrosaur dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (80-78 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: USA. Length: 8.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Hadrosauridae. Named by Joseph Leidy in 1858. First nearly complete dinosaur skeleton found in North America. Gave name to the duck-billed hadrosaur family.

datasets.name: Ceratosaurus
datasets.text: Ceratosaurus is a Ceratosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Jurassic period (153-148 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: USA, Tanzania, Portugal. Length: 6.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Ceratosauridae. Named by Othniel Charles Marsh in 1884. Large predator with a distinctive horn on its snout and bony spikes along its spine.

datasets.name: Plateosaurus
datasets.text: Plateosaurus is a Prosauropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Triassic period (214-204 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Germany, Switzerland, Greenland. Length: 8.0 meters. Taxonomy: Sauropodomorpha > Plateosauridae. Named by Hermann von Meyer in 1837. One of the first large dinosaurs, from the Triassic period. Could walk on two or four legs.

datasets.name: Kentrosaurus
datasets.text: Kentrosaurus is a Stegosaurid dinosaur that lived during the Late Jurassic period (155-152 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Tanzania. Length: 4.5 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Stegosauridae. Named by Edwin Hennig in 1915. African relative of Stegosaurus with a mix of plates and sharp spikes running along the back and tail.

datasets.name: Therizinosaurus
datasets.text: Therizinosaurus is a Therizinosaur theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (70-68 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Mongolia. Length: 10.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Therizinosauridae. Named by Evgeny Maleev in 1954. Had the longest claws of any known animal - up to 1 meter - used to pull down branches to feed.

datasets.name: Gallimimus
datasets.text: Gallimimus is a Ornithomimid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (70-68 million years ago). Diet: Omnivore. Found in: Mongolia. Length: 6.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Ornithomimidae. Named by Rinchen Barsbold, Osmólska & Roniewicz in 1972. Resembled an ostrich, one of the fastest dinosaurs. Toothless beak used to catch small animals and plants.

datasets.name: Pachyrhinosaurus
datasets.text: Pachyrhinosaurus is a Ceratopsid dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (73-69 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: USA, Canada. Length: 8.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Ceratopsidae. Named by Charles M. Sternberg in 1950. Unusual ceratopsid with a large bony boss (bump) instead of a nose horn, plus elaborate frill ornamentation.

datasets.name: Carcharodontosaurus
datasets.text: Carcharodontosaurus is a Large theropod dinosaur that lived during the Cretaceous period (99-93 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: Egypt, Morocco, Niger. Length: 13.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Carcharodontosauridae. Named by Ernst Stromer in 1931. North African giant predator with shark-like serrated teeth, rivaling T. rex in size.

datasets.name: Eoraptor
datasets.text: Eoraptor is a Basal dinosaur dinosaur that lived during the Late Triassic period (231-228 million years ago). Diet: Omnivore. Found in: Argentina. Length: 1.0 meters. Taxonomy: Dinosauria > Eodromaeus. Named by Paul Sereno in 1993. One of the earliest dinosaurs known, small and lightly built, giving insight into dinosaur origins.

datasets.name: Herrerasaurus
datasets.text: Herrerasaurus is a Basal theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Triassic period (231-228 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: Argentina. Length: 6.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Herrerasauridae. Named by Osvaldo Reig in 1963. Early predatory dinosaur from the Triassic. One of the first large dinosaurs and one of the first carnivores.

datasets.name: Mamenchisaurus
datasets.text: Mamenchisaurus is a Sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Jurassic period (160-145 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: China. Length: 26.0 meters. Taxonomy: Sauropoda > Mamenchisauridae. Named by Young Chung-Chien in 1954. Chinese sauropod with one of the longest necks relative to body size of any dinosaur.

datasets.name: Suchomimus
datasets.text: Suchomimus is a Spinosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (125-112 million years ago). Diet: Piscivore. Found in: Niger. Length: 11.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Spinosauridae. Named by Paul Sereno in 1998. Crocodile-mimic with a long narrow snout full of conical teeth, adapted for catching fish in rivers.

datasets.name: Utahraptor
datasets.text: Utahraptor is a Dromaeosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (126-125 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: USA. Length: 6.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Dromaeosauridae. Named by James Kirkland, Robert Gaston & Donald Burge in 1993. The largest known dromaeosaurid, with a 24-cm sickle claw - the real-life giant Velociraptor.

datasets.name: Stygimoloch
datasets.text: Stygimoloch is a Pachycephalosaurid dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (68-66 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: USA. Length: 3.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Pachycephalosauridae. Named by Peter Galton & Hans-Dieter Sues in 1983. Dome-headed dinosaur with elaborate horns and spikes, now thought by some to be a juvenile Pachycephalosaurus.

datasets.name: Megalosaurus
datasets.text: Megalosaurus is a Megalosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Middle Jurassic period (167-164 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: UK, France. Length: 6.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Megalosauridae. Named by William Buckland in 1824. The first dinosaur to receive a scientific name. A large predator from Jurassic England.

datasets.name: Hypsilophodon
datasets.text: Hypsilophodon is a Hypsilophodontid dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (130-125 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: UK, Spain. Length: 1.8 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Hypsilophodontidae. Named by Thomas Henry Huxley in 1869. Small, agile bipedal herbivore - once thought to live in trees, now known to be a fast ground-runner.

datasets.name: Corythosaurus
datasets.text: Corythosaurus is a Hadrosaur dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (77-75 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: USA, Canada. Length: 9.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Hadrosauridae. Named by Barnum Brown in 1914. Helmet-crested duck-billed dinosaur. The hollow crest amplified sounds for communication within the herd.

datasets.name: Edmontosaurus
datasets.text: Edmontosaurus is a Hadrosaur dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (73-66 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: USA, Canada. Length: 13.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Hadrosauridae. Named by Lawrence Lambe in 1917. One of the largest hadrosaurs, living alongside T. rex. Skin impressions show it had a pebbly texture.

datasets.name: Troodon
datasets.text: Troodon is a Troodontid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (77-66 million years ago). Diet: Omnivore. Found in: USA, Canada. Length: 2.4 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Troodontidae. Named by Joseph Leidy in 1856. Highly intelligent theropod with large eyes adapted for night hunting and a relatively large brain.

datasets.name: Microraptor
datasets.text: Microraptor is a Dromaeosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (125-120 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: China. Length: 0.8 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Dromaeosauridae. Named by Xu Xing in 2000. Remarkable four-winged dinosaur capable of gliding between trees, providing key evidence for bird evolution.

datasets.name: Sinoceratops
datasets.text: Sinoceratops is a Ceratopsid dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (73-66 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: China. Length: 6.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Ceratopsidae. Named by Xu Xing in 2010. The only large ceratopsid found in Asia, with a single nasal horn and elaborate frill with small spikes.

datasets.name: Baryonyx
datasets.text: Baryonyx is a Spinosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (130-125 million years ago). Diet: Piscivore. Found in: UK, Spain, Portugal. Length: 10.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Spinosauridae. Named by Alan Charig & Angela Milner in 1986. Discovered in England with fish scales in its stomach, proving it caught fish with its crocodile-like jaws.

datasets.name: Irritator
datasets.text: Irritator is a Spinosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (110-100 million years ago). Diet: Piscivore. Found in: Brazil. Length: 8.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Spinosauridae. Named by David Martill in 1996. Brazilian spinosaurid named because fossil dealers had altered the skull, irritating paleontologists.

datasets.name: Yangchuanosaurus
datasets.text: Yangchuanosaurus is a Metatetanuran theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Jurassic period (163-153 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: China. Length: 10.8 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Metatetanurae. Named by Dong, Chang, Li & Zhou in 1978. The largest predator in Jurassic China, with a large head and short arms.

datasets.name: Amargasaurus
datasets.text: Amargasaurus is a Dicraeosaurid sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (130-120 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Argentina. Length: 10.0 meters. Taxonomy: Sauropoda > Dicraeosauridae. Named by José Bonaparte & Jorge Calvo in 1991. Unusual sauropod with two rows of tall spines on its neck, possibly supporting a sail or hump.

datasets.name: Nigersaurus
datasets.text: Nigersaurus is a Rebbachisaurid sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Cretaceous period (119-99 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Niger. Length: 9.0 meters. Taxonomy: Sauropoda > Rebbachisauridae. Named by Paul Sereno in 1999. Bizarre sauropod with over 500 teeth arranged in a wide muzzle like a vacuum cleaner for low-ground grazing.

datasets.name: Concavenator
datasets.text: Concavenator is a Carcharodontosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (130-125 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: Spain. Length: 6.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Carcharodontosauridae. Named by Francisco Ortega, Fernando Escaso & José L. Sanz in 2010. Spanish predator with a distinctive hump on its back and possible quill knobs on its forearm.

datasets.name: Scipionyx
datasets.text: Scipionyx is a Compsognathid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (113 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: Italy. Length: 0.5 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Compsognathidae. Named by Giovanni Leonardi & Giorgio Teruzzi in 1998. Italian baby dinosaur fossil with preserved internal organs, including intestines and a liver.

datasets.name: Magyarosaurus
datasets.text: Magyarosaurus is a Titanosaur sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (70-66 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Romania. Length: 6.0 meters. Taxonomy: Sauropoda > Titanosauria. Named by Friedrich von Huene in 1932. Dwarf sauropod from ancient island Europe, illustrating how island conditions drive size reduction in large animals.

datasets.name: Psittacosaurus
datasets.text: Psittacosaurus is a Ceratopsian dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (126-101 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: China, Mongolia, Russia. Length: 2.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Psittacosauridae. Named by Henry Fairfield Osborn in 1923. Parrot-faced ceratopsian, one of the most common Cretaceous dinosaurs. Had bristle-like quills on its tail.

datasets.name: Nanuqsaurus
datasets.text: Nanuqsaurus is a Tyrannosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (69-66 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: USA (Alaska). Length: 6.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Tyrannosauridae. Named by Anthony Fiorillo & Ronald Tykoski in 2014. Polar tyrannosaurid that lived within the Arctic Circle, smaller than T. rex due to resource limitations.

datasets.name: Zhuchengtyrannus
datasets.text: Zhuchengtyrannus is a Tyrannosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (73-66 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: China. Length: 11.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Tyrannosauridae. Named by David Hone in 2011. Massive Chinese tyrannosaurid, one of the largest members of the family alongside T. rex.

datasets.name: Qianzhousaurus
datasets.text: Qianzhousaurus is a Tyrannosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (73-66 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: China. Length: 9.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Tyrannosauridae. Named by Lü Junchang in 2014. Long-snouted Chinese tyrannosaurid, nicknamed Pinocchio Rex for its unusually elongated snout.

datasets.name: Zuul
datasets.text: Zuul is a Ankylosaurid dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (76-75 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: USA, Canada. Length: 6.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Ankylosauridae. Named by Victoria Arbour & David Evans in 2017. Named after the Ghostbusters monster Zuul. The most complete ankylosaurid skeleton ever found in North America.

datasets.name: Dreadnoughtus
datasets.text: Dreadnoughtus is a Titanosaur sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (77-66 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Argentina. Length: 26.0 meters. Taxonomy: Sauropoda > Titanosauria. Named by Kenneth Lacovara in 2014. One of the most complete giant titanosaur specimens, estimated at 65 tonnes. Named after the dreadnought battleships.

datasets.name: Patagotitan
datasets.text: Patagotitan is a Titanosaur sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (101-98 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Argentina. Length: 37.0 meters. Taxonomy: Sauropoda > Titanosauria. Named by José Luis Carballido in 2017. Possibly the largest animal to ever walk the Earth, estimated at 69 tonnes. Found in Patagonia, Argentina.

datasets.name: Meraxes
datasets.text: Meraxes is a Carcharodontosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (96-92 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: Argentina. Length: 11.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Carcharodontosauridae. Named by Juan Canale in 2022. Recently described giant predator from Argentina, showing that large arms evolved independently in large theropods.

datasets.name: Lythronax
datasets.text: Lythronax is a Tyrannosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (80 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: USA. Length: 8.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Tyrannosauridae. Named by Mark Loewen in 2013. Goreback tyrannosaurid from Utah - one of the oldest members of the tyrannosaurid family found in North America.

datasets.name: Yutyrannus
datasets.text: Yutyrannus is a Proceratosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (125 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: China. Length: 9.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Proceratosauridae. Named by Xu Xing in 2012. The largest feathered dinosaur known, with long filamentous feathers covering its body in cold climate.

datasets.name: Dilophosaurus
datasets.text: Dilophosaurus is a Dilophosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Jurassic period (193 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: USA, China. Length: 6.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Dilophosauridae. Named by Samuel Paul Welles in 1954. Early Jurassic predator with two bony crests on its skull. Could not spit venom - that was a movie invention.

datasets.name: Coelophysis
datasets.text: Coelophysis is a Coelophysid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Triassic period (228-201 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: USA. Length: 3.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Coelophysidae. Named by Edward Drinker Cope in 1889. Slender early dinosaur found in huge numbers at Ghost Ranch, New Mexico. New Mexico's state fossil.

datasets.name: Segnosaurus
datasets.text: Segnosaurus is a Therizinosaur theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (102-86 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Mongolia. Length: 6.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Therizinosauridae. Named by Altangerel Perle in 1979. Unusual theropod with a pot-belly and leaf-shaped teeth adapted for eating plants instead of meat.

datasets.name: Edmontonia
datasets.text: Edmontonia is a Nodosaurid dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (76-66 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: USA, Canada. Length: 6.6 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Nodosauridae. Named by Charles W. Gilmore in 1930. Heavily armored nodosaurid with large shoulder spikes but no tail club, unlike its ankylosaurid cousins.

datasets.name: Torosaurus
datasets.text: Torosaurus is a Ceratopsid dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (68-66 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: USA, Canada. Length: 9.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Ceratopsidae. Named by Othniel Charles Marsh in 1891. Large ceratopsid with the biggest skull of any land animal, up to 3 meters long including the enormous frill.

datasets.name: Tsintaosaurus
datasets.text: Tsintaosaurus is a Hadrosaur dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (84-71 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: China. Length: 10.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Hadrosauridae. Named by Yang Zhongjian in 1958. Chinese hadrosaur with a distinctive unicorn-like crest on top of its head, unique among duck-billed dinosaurs.

datasets.name: Prenocephale
datasets.text: Prenocephale is a Pachycephalosaurid dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (70-68 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Mongolia. Length: 2.4 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Pachycephalosauridae. Named by Teresa Maryańska & Halszka Osmólska in 1974. Mongolian bone-head with a dome surrounded by nodes and bumps, used in ritualistic head-butting behavior.

datasets.name: Shantungosaurus
datasets.text: Shantungosaurus is a Hadrosaur dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (73-66 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: China. Length: 15.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Hadrosauridae. Named by Hu Chengzhi in 1973. The largest known hadrosaur and possibly the largest bipedal dinosaur ever, found in Shandong Province, China.

datasets.name: Rugops
datasets.text: Rugops is a Abelisaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Cretaceous period (95 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: Niger. Length: 6.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Abelisauridae. Named by Paul Sereno in 2004. Wrinkle-face African predator with a rough, pitted skull surface, possibly supporting display structures.

datasets.name: Rajasaurus
datasets.text: Rajasaurus is a Abelisaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (70-66 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: India. Length: 6.6 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Abelisauridae. Named by Paul Sereno & colleagues in 2003. Indian prince lizard from the Narmada valley, one of the few dinosaurs described from the Indian subcontinent.

datasets.name: Xenotarsosaurus
datasets.text: Xenotarsosaurus is a Abelisaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (90-85 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: Argentina. Length: 6.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Abelisauridae. Named by Martínez, Giménez, Rodríguez & Bochatey in 1986. South American predator known for its unusual fused ankle bones, giving it a unique posture.

datasets.name: Alectrosaurus
datasets.text: Alectrosaurus is a Tyrannosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (80-74 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: Mongolia, China. Length: 5.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Tyrannosauridae. Named by Charles Whitney Gilmore in 1933. Primitive tyrannosaurid from Asia with long arms compared to later relatives.

datasets.name: Bambiraptor
datasets.text: Bambiraptor is a Dromaeosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (75 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: USA. Length: 1.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Dromaeosauridae. Named by Burnham et al. in 2000. Small juvenile dromaeosaurid found in Montana, providing clues about the origin of bird flight.

datasets.name: Caudipteryx
datasets.text: Caudipteryx is a Oviraptorid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (125 million years ago). Diet: Omnivore. Found in: China. Length: 1.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Oviraptoridae. Named by Ji et al. in 1998. Feathered dinosaur with fan of tail feathers and wing feathers too short for flight.

datasets.name: Datousaurus
datasets.text: Datousaurus is a Sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Middle Jurassic period (175-163 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: China. Length: 14.0 meters. Taxonomy: Sauropoda > Datousauridae. Named by Dong & Tang in 1984. Early Chinese sauropod with a robust skull and spatulate teeth.

datasets.name: Einiosaurus
datasets.text: Einiosaurus is a Ceratopsid dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (74 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: USA. Length: 6.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Ceratopsidae. Named by Scott Sampson in 1995. Buffalo ceratopsid with a forward-curving nasal horn and two long backward-pointing frill spikes.

datasets.name: Fukuiraptor
datasets.text: Fukuiraptor is a Megaraptoran theropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (127-114 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: Japan. Length: 4.2 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Megaraptoridae. Named by Azuma & Currie in 2000. Japan's first large carnivorous dinosaur, showing Asia had diverse predator fauna during the Cretaceous.

datasets.name: Gondwanatitan
datasets.text: Gondwanatitan is a Titanosaur sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (70-65 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Brazil. Length: 7.0 meters. Taxonomy: Sauropoda > Titanosauria. Named by Kellner & Azevedo in 1999. Brazilian titanosaur showing the diversity of sauropods on the Gondwana supercontinent.

datasets.name: Huayangosaurus
datasets.text: Huayangosaurus is a Stegosaurid dinosaur that lived during the Middle Jurassic period (165-161 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: China. Length: 4.5 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Huayangosauridae. Named by Dong, Tang & Zhou in 1982. Primitive stegosaur from China with both plates and spikes, helping understand stegosaur evolution.

datasets.name: Incisivosaurus
datasets.text: Incisivosaurus is a Oviraptorid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (128 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: China. Length: 0.9 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Oviraptoridae. Named by Xu et al. in 2002. Remarkable oviraptorid with rodent-like front teeth, showing dietary diversity in this group.

datasets.name: Janenschia
datasets.text: Janenschia is a Titanosaur sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Jurassic period (155-150 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Tanzania. Length: 24.0 meters. Taxonomy: Sauropoda > Titanosauria. Named by Wild in 1991. African titanosaur from the Tendaguru Formation, contemporary with Brachiosaurus.

datasets.name: Khaan
datasets.text: Khaan is a Oviraptorid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (75-71 million years ago). Diet: Omnivore. Found in: Mongolia. Length: 1.8 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Oviraptoridae. Named by Clark, Norell & Barsbold in 2001. Mongolian oviraptorid named after a Mongolian word for lord or ruler.

datasets.name: Limusaurus
datasets.text: Limusaurus is a Ceratosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Jurassic period (161-155 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: China. Length: 1.7 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Ceratosauridae. Named by Xu et al. in 2009. Toothless Chinese dinosaur that changed diet from carnivore to herbivore as it grew up.

datasets.name: Minmi
datasets.text: Minmi is a Ankylosaurid dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (119-113 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Australia. Length: 3.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Ankylosauria. Named by Ralph Molnar in 1980. Australia's most complete dinosaur, an armored ankylosaur with unusually small body armor segments.

datasets.name: Neovenator
datasets.text: Neovenator is a Neovenatorid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (130-125 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: UK. Length: 7.5 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Neovenatoridae. Named by Hutt et al. in 1996. Britain's best large theropod fossil, found on the Isle of Wight.

datasets.name: Othnielia
datasets.text: Othnielia is a Hypsilophodontid dinosaur that lived during the Late Jurassic period (155-148 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: USA. Length: 1.4 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Hypsilophodontidae. Named by Peter Galton in 1977. Small swift herbivore named in honor of paleontologist Othniel Charles Marsh.

datasets.name: Puertasaurus
datasets.text: Puertasaurus is a Titanosaur sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (69-65 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Argentina. Length: 30.0 meters. Taxonomy: Sauropoda > Titanosauria. Named by Novas et al. in 2005. Gigantic Patagonian titanosaur with the widest vertebrae of any known dinosaur.

datasets.name: Quilmesaurus
datasets.text: Quilmesaurus is a Abelisaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (72-66 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: Argentina. Length: 6.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Abelisauridae. Named by Coria in 2001. Argentine predator known only from leg bones, but clearly an abelisaurid from its bone structure.

datasets.name: Rhoetosaurus
datasets.text: Rhoetosaurus is a Sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Middle Jurassic period (175-164 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Australia. Length: 15.0 meters. Taxonomy: Sauropoda > Rhoetosauridae. Named by Longman in 1926. Australia's oldest sauropod and one of the world's oldest complete sauropod specimens.

datasets.name: Sinornithosaurus
datasets.text: Sinornithosaurus is a Dromaeosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (125-122 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: China. Length: 1.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Dromaeosauridae. Named by Xu et al. in 1999. Chinese feathered dromaeosaurid, one of the closest non-avian relatives of birds.

datasets.name: Tarchia
datasets.text: Tarchia is a Ankylosaurid dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (74-70 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Mongolia. Length: 8.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Ankylosauridae. Named by Maryańska in 1977. Largest known Asian ankylosaurid, with a massive tail club capable of shattering predator bones.

datasets.name: Unenlagia
datasets.text: Unenlagia is a Dromaeosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period (90-88 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: Argentina. Length: 2.3 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Dromaeosauridae. Named by Novas & Puerta in 1997. Half-bird from Argentina - its shoulder anatomy shows dromaeosaurids could fold their arms like birds.

datasets.name: Vulcanodon
datasets.text: Vulcanodon is a Basal sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Jurassic period (200-180 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: Zimbabwe. Length: 6.5 meters. Taxonomy: Sauropoda > Vulcanodontidae. Named by Raath in 1972. Very early African sauropod bridging the gap between prosauropods and true sauropods.

datasets.name: Wuerhosaurus
datasets.text: Wuerhosaurus is a Stegosaurid dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (130-120 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: China. Length: 7.0 meters. Taxonomy: Ornithischia > Stegosauridae. Named by Dong Zhiming in 1973. The last known stegosaur, surviving into the Cretaceous long after most stegosaurs had gone extinct.

datasets.name: Xenoposeidon
datasets.text: Xenoposeidon is a Sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (140 million years ago). Diet: Herbivore. Found in: UK. Length: 15.0 meters. Taxonomy: Sauropoda > Xenoposeidonidae. Named by Taylor & Naish in 2007. Mysterious British sauropod known from a single unusual vertebra unlike any other sauropod.

datasets.name: Yixianosaurus
datasets.text: Yixianosaurus is a Dromaeosaurid theropod dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period (125 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: China. Length: 1.0 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Dromaeosauridae. Named by Xu & Wang in 2003. Long-armed Chinese dinosaur whose limb proportions suggest it was adapted for tree-climbing.

datasets.name: Zuolong
datasets.text: Zuolong is a Coelurosaur theropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Jurassic period (161-155 million years ago). Diet: Carnivore. Found in: China. Length: 3.1 meters. Taxonomy: Theropoda > Coelurosauria. Named by Choiniere et al. in 2010. Chinese coelurosaur near the origin of the group that includes birds, tyrannosaurs, and dromaeosaurids.
